text.p: - The idea of building a cheap car for the people, promoted by former entrepreneur and federal Security Council vice-secretary Boris Berezovsky, who managed to collect $50 million for the project, has never lived up to expectations.
- Russian scientists have set up a special work team to predict natural disasters.
- Ukraine registered a case of "mad cow" but Ukrainian veterinarians say the strain is less dangerous than the sort in Britain.
- Former security chief Alexander Lebed, on a visit to Paris, said that allegations by Forbes magazine of impropriety by Berezovsky are true.
- Anatoly Kulikov, first deputy prime minister in charge of tax collection, said he would rather encourage than force tax dodgers to pay.
- Drastic measures to improve tax collection should go hand in hand with tax reform, Sevodnya said in an editorial.
- Russia showed a subtle shift in its foreign policy by heartily welcoming Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat shortly before Western politicians arrived in Moscow.
- "Popular capitalism" in Russia has proved a failure.
- Anatoly Kulikov, deputy prime minister in charge of tax collection, says he does not know how many different taxes there are in Russia.
